name: America the Beautiful — NPS Pass
description: The National Park Service offers lifetime and annual passes providing access to over 2,000 federal recreation sites across the United States, including national parks, wildlife refuges, and forests.
fullDescription: The National Park Service offers lifetime and annual passes providing access to over 2,000 federal recreation sites across the United States, including national parks, wildlife refuges, and forests.
whatTheyOffer:
- Senior Pass (U.S. citizens/residents 62+): $80 lifetime or $20 annual
- Military Pass: Free annual pass for current U.S. military and dependents
- Military Lifetime Pass: Free for veterans and Gold Star Family members
- Access Pass: Free lifetime pass for U.S. citizens/residents with a permanent disability
- 4th Grade Pass: Free annual pass for U.S. fourth graders
- Annual Pass: $80 for U.S. residents ($250 for non-residents)
- All passes cover entrance fees and standard amenity fees
howToGetIt: Get a pass in person at one of 1,000+ federal recreation sites, order online from the USGS Store (allow about 3 weeks for delivery), or buy a digital pass through Recreation.gov. Access and military passes require documentation of eligibility.
keywords: America the Beautiful, National Park pass, senior pass, military pass, Access pass, disability pass, $80 lifetime, annual pass, national parks
